recap.text: A caprid liaison sits in on interviews between crawlers and sponsors. He tells Carl to his face that he is working to have Carl and Prepotente disposed of. During another interview, the liaison stands in shadow with an avatar taller than the ceiling and his head half cut off. He blinks and disappears without a word while a crawler weighs three candidates.

Orren threatens a tall and invisible person with venting into the ocean depths, and Harbinger leaves the call. Orren tells Carl that the team caught a hidden conversation between Carl and the residual. Harbinger sent an order to have Carl killed, but the AI intervened.

Harbinger, a liaison expelled from the herd, teleports into the Plenty's studio with an enormous pulse rifle. He calls the matriarch Mother and tells her he is lonely. He raises the rifle at Crawler Carl, but the AI intervenes and puts everything inside the goat outside the goat.

beats.headline: He says so to their faces
beats.text: Subject is a caprid liaison, sent to sit in wherever a crawler might be alone with a sponsor. At the end of the first interview he sits in on, he tells Carl to his face that Carl needs to be removed from the crawl, and that he is actively working to have both Carl and Prepotente disposed of. I record this as a courtesy on his part. Most of the people trying that do not announce it.
beats.gist: Harbinger is a caprid liaison who tells Carl he is working to dispose of Carl and Prepotente.

beats.headline: Gone without a word
beats.text: Subject stood through the interview in shadow at the back of the hold, his avatar taller than the ceiling and his head half cut off by it, having warned beforehand that he would stop the whole thing at the first privileged detail. The princess raised Captain Enormous and he did not react; he appeared distracted, which is unusual for him. While the crawler weighed his three candidates, subject blinked and disappeared without a word of explanation. The room looked at itself. The lawyer shrugged.
beats.gist: Harbinger disappears without a word after the crawler weighs three candidates.

beats.headline: The order to have Carl killed
beats.text: Orren threatens someone tall and invisible with venting into the ocean depths, and then Harbinger is no longer on the call. Orren tells Carl how they worked it out. One sentence, Welcome to the party, pals, frightened his team more than anything ever has, and a few hours ago they finally caught the hidden conversation between Carl and the residual. Harbinger sent an order to have Carl killed. The AI intervened on his behalf.
beats.gist: Orren threatens someone tall and invisible with venting into the ocean depths, and Harbinger leaves the call.

beats.headline: He exerts himself
beats.text: Harbinger, liaison, expelled from the herd, teleports into the Plenty's studio carrying an enormous pulse rifle and addresses the matriarch as Mother. He warned her. She did not listen. He has been alone in this, and he is lonely. Exertion, he reminds her, is meant to be an expression of joy. He will exert himself now: protect the herd, protect the universe, and do what should have been done from the start. He raises the rifle at Crawler Carl. The AI intervenes. Everything inside the goat is suddenly outside the goat.
beats.gist: Harbinger teleports into the Plenty's studio with an enormous pulse rifle and addresses the matriarch as Mother.
